translation: The Sanjiao extends from the head to the heart, from the heart to the navel, and from the navel to the foot, constituting the upper, middle, and lower Sanjiao; in reality it is the single primordial qi. Therefore it is said to have a viscus but no bowel. The Maijue (Pulse Song) says: The Sanjiao has no form and only an empty name, lodged in the chest corresponding to the diaphragm.
